summary: Editable matrix of roles and permissions with row and column selection.
whenNotToUse: Authorizing operations: security checks must remain on the server.

props.name: roles
props.description: Columns with unique ids and names.

props.name: permissions
props.description: Rows with unique ids and names.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onChange
props.description: Map from role id to selected permission ids.

props.name: isCellDisabled / showBulkActions
props.description: Locks individual cells and configures bulk selection.

accessibility: Row and column headers, cell names and mixed state for bulk selections.
responsive: The table scrolls within its container.
customization: Colors and spacing come from tokens.
commonMistakes: Do not use the client-side matrix as an authorization check.
limits: Persistence and authorization are delegated to the consumer.
